svg.aria-label: Sketch after a CBS News photograph: a march in Paris at dusk. A large French tricolour, held up on a thin pole from the crowd, fills the upper centre of the frame, its bands drawn in hatching and its cloth folded by the wind. Below it a dense crowd of marchers fills the lower third, drawn as overlapping rounded heads and shoulders with their backs to the viewer and no faces; a few arms are raised. A row of small police lights runs across the middle distance. A street lamp stands at left, a tram-wire mast at right, two overhead cables cross the sky, with a dark apartment block at upper left and bare trees at upper right.
